detail: Manoj Kumar Upadhyay has submitted a mandatory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, concerning acquisition of shares in Acme Solar Holdings Limited.
